research_line: existing-drug repurposing screen in cancer cell lines (v1b)
status: pre-registered hypothesis ranking from public cell-line viability; no clinical efficacy, safety, achievable human exposure or patient benefit claim

sources.discovery_and_confirmation: PRISM Repurposing 19Q4 Dataset, Broad Institute, figshare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.9393293.v4, CC BY 4.0; Corsello et al. 2020 Nature Cancer 1:235-248
sources.independent_assay: CTRP v2 expanded dataset (CTRPv2.0_2015_ctd2_ExpandedDataset), Broad Institute, NCI CTD2 Network, Index of NCI Studies CTD2_066
sources.ctd2_acknowledgement: The results published here are in whole or part based upon data generated by the Cancer Target Discovery and Development (CTD2) Network (https://ocg.cancer.gov/programs/ctd2/data-portal) established by the National Cancer Institute's Office of Cancer Genomics.
sources.modification: MAEN computed compound-level aggregates; no source rows are redistributed

rules.kill_rule: primary log2 fold change strictly below log2(0.3), i.e. under 30% viability relative to vehicle
rules.separation: P(hit AUC < non-hit AUC) + 0.5 P(tie); hits and non-hits fixed by the primary screen; lower AUC is more sensitive

bootstrap.unit: cell lines resampled with replacement within hit and non-hit groups
bootstrap.seed_derivation: first 16 SHA256 hex digits of seed:stage:compound

permutation.unit: stage AUC values shuffled across the shared hit and non-hit lines
permutation.rule: identical separation threshold and bootstrap lower-bound rule; one draw, no retries

positive_controls.expectation: primary class selective and secondary status confirmed
positive_controls.interpretation: reported individually; thresholds are never retuned after a control result

rules.amendment: v1a, before any response value was read: MTS010 preference and skipping cell-info rows without a DepMap ID (control barcodes), both from the provider README; download MD5 checked when the provider publishes it; thresholds unchanged
rules.amendment_v1b: after the v1a inventory stopped on row labels, before any response statistic: cell-info rows without a DepMap ID include 10 failed-STR lines whose labels also appear as response rows; following the original failed-STR exclusion, those rows are dropped and counted in every stage; thresholds unchanged

interpretation.scope: Post-result wording correction; frozen rules, summary and candidate values are unchanged.
interpretation.primary_hit: A relative viable-cell abundance proxy below 30% of vehicle control; growth arrest and cell death are not distinguished. Legacy kill/lines_killed field names are retained for provenance, not as proof of cell death.
interpretation.confirmation_and_replication: Relative AUC separation of primary hit and non-hit lines; neither repeated absolute inhibition below 30% nor cell death is a pass requirement.
interpretation.table_47: Post-hoc display group: phase Launched, secondary confirmed, and disease_area containing neither oncology nor malignancy in the historical Repurposing Hub metadata. The 47 include veterinary compounds and compounds with oncology uses; current human approval, jurisdiction, formulation and route have not been verified.
interpretation.lineage: primary_tissue describes tissue of origin; skin alone does not establish melanoma histology or BRAF mutation status.
interpretation.structure: Structural and response similarity can suggest an association; identifying a causal active fragment requires additional evidence and inactive analogues. No structure analysis was performed in this screen.

limitations: cultured cancer cell lines only; no human efficacy, safety, exposure or normal-cell toxicity
the pre-registered oncology flag only matches "oncology", so hematologic-malignancy drugs are counted as non-oncology in summary.launched_non_oncology_tiers
some selective hits may reflect nonspecific membrane toxicity or sample identity/purity issues; compound identity was not re-verified
CTRP shares many cell lines and the Broad Institute with PRISM; it is a different assay, not a different laboratory
relative viable-cell abundance and relative AUC separation do not establish cell death or normal-cell selectivity
one fixed shuffle per compound is a descriptive control; individual permutation p-values, false discovery rates and candidate true-positive probabilities were not estimated
bootstrap intervals resample cell lines within hit and non-hit groups; related cell-line origins are not clustered and their dependence is not represented
2.5 uM is the nominal primary concentration; recorded selected doses vary, including 1.04 to 5.0 uM among the 710 selective candidates
Launched and disease-area annotations come from historical metadata and do not verify present human non-oncology approval
